instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: Do you think this illustration was drawn on paper or with a computer programme?
atoms.b: Do you think this ((illustration)) was drawn on paper or with a computer programme?

atoms.a: Nothing is impossible, you just have to believe in yourself!
atoms.b: Nothing is ((impossible)), you just have to believe in yourself!

atoms.a: My great-grandmother has some gorgeous gems in her jewellery. One of them is really brilliant.
atoms.b: My great-grandmother has some gorgeous gems in her jewellery. One of them is really ((brilliant)).

atoms.a: They distributed the bulletin with the school’s magazine.
atoms.b: They distributed the ((bulletin)) with the school’s magazine.

atoms.a: Most of the time you’ll find him in the library. College students have to study a lot for their A-levels.
atoms.b: Most of the time you’ll find him in the library. ((College)) students have to study a lot for their A-levels.

atoms.a: Ideally, teachers should compliment their students for their good work.
atoms.b: Ideally, teachers should ((compliment)) their students for their good work.
